text: Opal server, administrator: Administration > DataSHIELD > Packages > Add package > GitHub, user datashield, package dsCoda. R opalr: Rock server package must part Rock R image; add alongside dsBase building image, publish DataSHIELD settings Opal. server also needs dsBase, dsTidyverse analysts use tibble-based regression workflow described dsCodaClient vignette. local development testing without Opal, install package R library load DSLite:
